title: What's Your Growth Mindset Superpower?
description: Everyone grows differently — and everyone has one move they're secretly great at. What's yours?

answers.text: Sting for an hour, come back stronger by dinner
Ask three follow-up questions
Pick one small thing to fix this week
Zoom out — it's one scene, not the movie
Enjoy being bad at it — that's day one
Research why it works the way it does
Practice five minutes daily, no more
Join a beginner group and cheer everyone on

questions.text: A new skill you're bad at (for now). You:

answers.text: 'Again'
'Why'
'Imagine'
'You can'

questions.text: A friend stumbles at something. You say:

answers.text: 'Great — the first try is just data'
'What's the smallest next step?'
'Where does this fit in the bigger story?'
'I've seen you do harder things'

questions.text: Pick a plant that matches your growth style:

answers.text: A vine exploring every direction
Moss. Slow, steady, unstoppable.
An oak thinking in centuries
A sunflower turning everyone toward the light

questions.text: Your reaction to 'we've always done it this way':

answers.text: 'And how's that going?' (kindly)
'Interesting — why, though?'
'Could we change just one small part?'
'Here's where that road eventually leads'
Speak badly to strangers immediately
Fall down grammar rabbit holes, happily
Learn ten words a day, every day
Start a study group by week two

questions.text: Your notebook margins are full of:

answers.text: Crossed-out attempts, kept proudly
Question marks and arrows
Maps of where this all leads
Notes to share with someone later
Are first to say 'okay, round two'
Find the one piece still salvageable
Remind everyone what it's all for
Check on the person taking it hardest

questions.text: A setback strikes the group project. You:

answers.text: 'Stay curious'
'Inch by inch'
'Play the long game'
'We grow better together'

results.description: Your superpower is perspective. Setbacks shrink when you zoom out, and you help everyone remember that today's stumble is one paragraph in a very long, very good story.
Your superpower is resilience. Falling doesn't scare you because getting up is your signature move — every 'again' makes you a little harder to stop.
Your superpower is wonder. 'Why' is your favorite tool, rabbit holes are your natural habitat, and your questions unlock doors other people walk straight past.
Your superpower is lifting others. You grow by helping people believe in themselves, and everything you touch — teams, friendships, group chats — grows with you.
Your superpower is the small, doable next thing. While others wait for motivation, you quietly stack tiny wins — and tiny wins, it turns out, build mountains.
